name: Bubble Chart
summary: Four-dimensional scatter — x, y, bubble area and colour — with a nested-circle size key, top-N labels, log axes and an optional animated timeline.
summary_zh: 四维散点图：横轴、纵轴、气泡面积、颜色；嵌套圆尺寸图例、最大气泡标注、对数轴，可按时间字段播放动画。
description_zh: 在散点图基础上用气泡面积（按平方根缩放，面积与数值成正比）和颜色再表达两个维度，例如“增速 × 利润率 × 市值 × 行业”或“国家收入 × 增速 × 员工数 × 区域”。颜色可以是类别（图例可点击隐藏）或连续数值（顶部色带，可拖动手柄过滤）；右侧嵌套圆为尺寸图例，只给最大的 N 个气泡加标签以保持版面干净，目标公司用强调色。指定 timeField 后按期间生成时间轴，点击播放观察气泡移动并留下轨迹，适合情景或历年演变。
best_for: Peer positioning on growth vs. margin, sized by market cap
Country / segment portfolio maps (revenue × growth × headcount)
Valuation heat on top of an operating map (continuous colour)
avoid_when: Size differences under ~2x (area differences are hard to read; use scatter)
Precise value comparison (use bar or table)

size.desc: Bubble area (√-scaled diameter); non-positive values draw as hollow minimum bubbles

label.desc: Short bubble label (ticker / ISO code); also the cross-filter field

name.desc: Full name for the tooltip title; also the trail key in timeline mode

target.desc: Rows where this field is true are highlighted as the target

timeField.desc: Period field (year, quarter): one frame per period with a play button

startAt.desc: 'last' | 'first' — period shown before playing; play on the last period replays from the first (print shows the last)

autoPlay.desc: Start playing the timeline when rendered (never in print / reduced motion)

trails.desc: Timeline: faint path of each bubble through the periods so far

labels.desc: Label the N largest bubbles (true = all, false = none); labels sit inside big bubbles or in the first free spot around small ones, the target is always labelled

sizeLegend.desc: Nested-circle size key in the right gutter

sizeTitle.desc: Size key title (defaults to the size field title)

colorTitle.desc: Continuous colour legend title (defaults to the colour field title)

refLines.desc: [{axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label, color}] dashed reference lines (default colour: the theme reference-line colour)

highlight.desc: Label / name value(s) drawn as the target; default uses the target channel

peerLabel.desc: Legend name when there is no category colour

xFormat.desc: X format (defaults to the field format)

yFormat.desc: Y format (defaults to the field format)

sizeFormat.desc: Size format for the key and tooltip

xTitle.desc: X axis title (defaults to the field title)

yTitle.desc: Y axis title (defaults to the field title)

tooltipFields.desc: Extra fields listed in the tooltip

brush.desc: Box-select tool that cross-filters the label field (not in timeline mode)

zoom.desc: Box zoom, Ctrl + wheel zoom, drag to pan and the hover toolbar

wheelZoom.desc: true = a plain mouse wheel zooms; default: Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or a trackpad pinch zooms, so the wheel keeps scrolling the report

interactions: Hover tooltip with all four dimensions
Click a bubble to cross-filter (toggle); box-select several
Legend toggles categories; continuous colour band handles filter by value
Box zoom, Ctrl + wheel zoom, drag to pan, reset
Timeline play / scrub with animated transitions and trails
